title: Video face detailer
description: BLOCKED 2026-08-17 on MPI-568 (LTX spatial upscaler bench) - Fabio: the results of MPI-568 decide whether this card's step-5 sampler bench is even the right shape, so 568 runs first. Do not start MPI-557 until MPI-568 reports. Detail small faces in video without per-frame identity flicker: crop a stable face window, resample it with a TEMPORAL sampler, graft only its high frequencies back. Experimental - Phase 0 is a bench GO/NO-GO before any app work. UNBLOCKED 2026-08-15: the SeedVR2 node choice is settled - the BUNDLED CORE NODES win a measured bake-off against the numz pack (core resolves ~50% more detail at matched chunk size, and BlockSwap does not fix the OOM). Take comfy_extras.nodes_seedvr as the sampler. Evidence: MPI-506 brief 2f-ter. STEP-5 IS NOW A THREE-WAY BENCH, 2026-08-16 (Fabio): add a plain .pth upscale-with-model arm (ImageUpscaleWithModel - 4x_NMKD-Siax_200k, or better 1x-ITF-SkinDiffDetail-Lite-v1, a 1x skin-detail model that never rescales) and compare it HEAD-TO-HEAD against SeedVR2 on the same crop, with LTX v2v as the regenerative third. .pth has no temporal model, so no chunking, no VRAM ceiling, seconds not minutes - but also no temporal coherence, so bench for FLICKER, not sharpness. Do NOT restate this as 'they are equivalent': at full frame SIAX measures mid 1.23 / top 1.10 against lanczos (near no-op) vs SeedVR2's 6.18 / 3.50; the open question is whether that gap still matters at 128x128 crop scale. SCOPE OF THE SEEDVR2 DROP: MPI-506's standalone plugin feature is dropped (sharpens rather than reconstructs, no semantic prior, ~10 min per second at 3x), but SeedVR2 REMAINS a live candidate inside this workflow - Fabio: 'SeedVR2 is still usable in that workflow of the Video Face Detailer'. On a face crop the VRAM and runtime objections largely evaporate (~100x fewer pixels than a full frame).
